question: Which of the following countries does NOT share its land boundary with India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tajikistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tajikistan does NOT share a land boundary with India.
 
• India shares its land boundaries with 7 countries: Afghanistan, Pakistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar.
 
• Although Tajikistan is in close proximity to India, the two countries do not have a direct land border.
 
• The narrow Wakhan Corridor in Afghanistan separates India from Tajikistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India's Borders:**

 
 
• India shares its longest border with Bangladesh, which is approximately 4,096 kilometers long.
 
• The India-China border is around 3,488 kilometers long and is known as the Line of Actual Control (LAC).
 
• India's border with Pakistan is around 3,323 kilometers long and includes the Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu & Kashmir.
 
• India shares a 1,751 kilometers long border with Nepal.
 
• The India-Bhutan border is about 699 kilometers long.
 
• The India-Myanmar border is approximately 1,643 kilometers long.
 
• India shares a relatively short border with Afghanistan, about 106 kilometers long, in the region of Jammu & Kashmir.
 
 
 
• **Wakhan Corridor:**
 
 
• The Wakhan Corridor is a narrow strip of territory in Afghanistan, extending to China and separating Tajikistan from Pakistan.
 
• It is approximately 350 kilometers long and is historically significant as a trade route.
 
• The corridor acts as a buffer zone between India and Tajikistan.
 
• It is sparsely populated and has limited infrastructure.
